# Lehigh Valley Auto Detailing

> Interior and exterior car detailing in Coopersburg, PA. Drop off in Coopersburg or book mobile detailing at your driveway within 25 miles. Prices are listed up front, there is no deposit and no cancellation fee, and payment is due when the service is complete.

- Phone: (484) 719-1144 (call or text)
- Email: noah@lehighvalleyautodetailing.com
- Location: Coopersburg, PA 18036 (drop-off address sent when the appointment is confirmed)
- Hours: By appointment
- Owner: Noah Malek
- Service area (drop-off and mobile): Coopersburg, Center Valley, Hellertown, Quakertown, Fountain Hill, Emmaus, Bethlehem, Allentown, Wescosville, Pennsburg, Macungie, Perkasie, Catasauqua, Whitehall, Trexlertown, Breinigsville, Coplay, Nazareth, Northampton and Easton. Mobile service up to 25 miles from Coopersburg.

## Services and prices

Prices are Car / Sedan, SUV / Truck, Large SUV / Van.

- Full Detail Refresh (interior + exterior): $115 / $140 / $165
- Full Detail Complete (interior + exterior, most popular): $220 / $260 / $300
- Full Detail Ultimate (interior + exterior): $285 / $340 / $385
- Basic Interior Clean: $80 / $100 / $120
- Standard Interior Detail: $150 / $175 / $200
- Deep Interior Restoration: $225 / $260 / $300
- Maintenance Wash & Dry: $50 / $60 / $70
- Full Exterior Detail: $100 / $120 / $140
- Pet Hair Removal add-on: $30 to $50
- Mobile travel fee: +$40 (Zone 1), +$60 (15 to 25 miles from Coopersburg)
- Maintenance Plan (after one Full Detail; basic interior clean + hand wash each visit; month to month): Monthly $99 / $119 / $139 per month, Every 2 Weeks $189 / $229 / $269 per month; mobile plan visits in Zone 1 +$20 per visit
